name: Lot The
overview: The topic "Lot The" in Scripture primarily centers on the divine practice of casting lots to discern God's will in various circumstances. This is evident in Leviticus 16, where Aaron casts lots to select one goat for the LORD and another as the scapegoat, symbolizing atonement and removal of sin. Additionally, the allocation of the land of Canaan among the tribes of Israel was determined by casting lots, as described in Numbers 26 and Joshua 18, emphasizing God's sovereign guidance in the distribution of inheritance. The use of lots also extended to organizing the tribes and families for specific purposes, underscoring the principle that God's providence governs both judgment and inheritance.
